scope: Scientific evidence relevant to BHOC and transplant oxygen delivery. These records are external transplantation studies and are not BHOC efficacy evidence.

records.title: Hypothermic Oxygenated Perfusion Versus Static Cold Storage in Liver Transplantation: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Trials
records.authors: Ellouze A, Tzedakis S, Zorkot MA, et al.
records.population: 8 randomized trials; 984 adult liver transplant recipients
records.signal: HOPE was associated with lower early allograft dysfunction, primary non-function, major complications and biliary complications than static cold storage; one-year graft survival was comparable.
records.relevance: Directly relevant to oxygenated preservation, ischemia-reperfusion injury and measurable graft outcomes.
records.boundary: Not a BHOC study and does not establish a role for BHOC in perfusion.

records.title: Machine Perfusion Parameters and 1-Year Outcomes in High KDPI Kidney Transplantation: A Single-Center Cohort Study
records.authors: Foster CE, Filardi KFXC, Hanna J, Dar W, Emmanuel B, Morgan G, Serrano OK
records.signal: Pre-specified machine-perfusion flow and resistance groups did not show statistically significant differences in one-year renal function, graft survival or patient survival.
records.relevance: Supports testing whether perfusion measurements are meaningful surrogates for tissue-level benefit and graft function.
records.boundary: Observational single-center evidence; not a BHOC or oxygen-carrier study.

records.title: Early-to-Midterm Outcomes of Lung Transplantation Following Procurement with Thoracoabdominal Regional Perfusion: An OPTN Analysis
records.authors: O'Neill J, Gregorio PHP, Hassaballa A, et al.
records.journal: The Journal of Heart and Lung Transplantation
records.population: DCD lung transplantation; 1364 standard rapid recovery and 261 TA-NRP recipients
records.signal: One- and three-year survival were comparable. After adjustment, TA-NRP recipients had lower odds of ECMO use at 72 hours.
records.relevance: Relevant to regional perfusion, procurement physiology, preservation and oxygen-delivery questions across organs.
records.boundary: Registry evidence; not a BHOC or oxygen-carrier study.

records.title: Real-World Analysis of Hypothermic Oxygenated Perfusion and Normothermic Machine Perfusion in Liver Transplantation: An International Cohort Study
records.authors: Pfister M, Eden J, Rasel H, et al.
records.signal: The study compared contemporary HOPE and NMP practice across international cohorts with substantial baseline donor-risk differences and risk-adjusted analyses.
records.relevance: Relevant to how different oxygenated perfusion strategies are selected, measured and compared in real-world transplantation.
records.boundary: Non-randomized real-world comparison; not BHOC evidence.

records.title: Real-World Use of Normothermic Machine Perfusion in Liver Transplantation: A Multi-Institutional Experience From the National Organ Perfusion Registry
records.authors: Cortez AR, Loh WS, Sheskey S, et al.
records.population: 545 NMP liver transplants across nine U.S. centers
records.signal: The registry described diverse NMP practice and reported a 90-day death-censored graft failure rate of 1.7%.
records.relevance: Relevant to deployment, perfusion logistics, viability assessment and outcome measurement in contemporary machine perfusion.
records.boundary: Descriptive multicenter registry evidence without a randomized control group; not BHOC evidence.

records.title: Results of Two Cases of Pig-to-Human Kidney Xenotransplantation
records.authors: Montgomery RA, Stern JM, Lonze BE, et al.
records.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
records.population: Two recipients with established brain death; 54-hour observation
records.signal: The authors reported urine production and no biopsy evidence of hyperacute or antibody-mediated rejection during the 54-hour observation.
records.relevance: External context for the xenograft pathway and early organ-function assessment.
records.boundary: Short-term decedent research, not long-term living-recipient evidence. No BHOC or oxygen-carrier intervention was tested.
records.reviewScope: Editorial check of original bibliographic record and abstract; not independent verification of underlying data.
records.classification: External transplantation research; not BHOC efficacy evidence

records.title: Physiology and immunology of a pig-to-human decedent kidney xenotransplant
records.authors: Montgomery RA, Stern JM, Fathi F, Suek N, et al.
records.population: One recipient with established brain death; planned 61-day observation
records.signal: Dialysis independence was achieved. Antibody-mediated rejection developed on day 33; the authors reported reversal after treatment.
records.relevance: External context for interpreting graft function alongside immune response in the xenograft pathway.
records.boundary: Not 61 rejection-free days. A single decedent study cannot establish long-term living-recipient outcomes or BHOC benefit; no oxygen-carrier intervention was tested.
records.reviewScope: Editorial check of original bibliographic record, abstract and correction trail; no figure-level reanalysis or independent data audit.
records.classification: External transplantation research; not BHOC efficacy evidence
